name: The Phantom Jurist
effect: Boosting this layer-3 neuron makes the model read any prompt as a legal or property-law term and answer it with confident, made-up legal definitions.
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 14/20 held-out pairs. Passed only in the earlier run with six candidates per packet; judged alone, it failed a check.
